title: Review of c22's wave-pinning crawler front repair: Supported for I, M, R on fresh seeds 5 and 6 and at dt/2. The repair restores the cell's polarity and crawling but not its size, and a 45% cut kills the cell
summary: I re-ran c22's world unchanged: a labkit pack with the t=8 front cut on new seeds 5 and 6 (rerun_front/), and cutrun.py's branched twin-vs-cut on seeds 5 and 6 (cuts/s5_front30, cuts/s6_front30). On both seeds the 30% leading-edge cut (27% of area, 31-32% of protein removed) splits the front into two lateral domains. Within about 3 time units one domain wins, and the cell crawls on as a single-front half-moon at 0.384-0.385 against its twin's 0.418-0.421. A real numerical variant, dt halved inside the world (WORLD_P dt=5e-4), gives the same course: speed 0.416 against a twin at 0.454. Two limits that the claim does not spell out: the repaired cell keeps only 66% of its twin's area (1.73-1.75 vs 2.61-2.63, with no regrowth over 10 time units), so only polarity and motility are repaired, not the body. And a 45% front cut on seed 6 (45% of area, 53% of protein) kills the cell by t=8.8, so the cell repairs inside a narrow window.

observations.I: rerun_front/seed5/sheet.png and seed6/sheet.png: one bounded cell, 91/91 frames, from t=0 to t=18
observations.M: cuts/s6_front30/cut.png: the undamaged twin crawls 4.2 units (over 2 body diameters) in 10 time units at 0.418 with its shape kept; rerun_front/seed6/sheet.png crawls about 3 domain-wraps of distance before the cut
observations.R: cuts/s5_front30/cut.png and cuts/s6_front30/cut.png: cut at t=8 (area 0.264-0.267, protein 0.314-0.317 removed). Two front domains at t=9.3-10.5, one front from t~11.5, then crawls at 0.384/0.385 (twin 0.421/0.418). Polarized area returns to 0.91-0.96 (twin 1.11-1.17)

seeds_run.result: pass: single front by t~11.5, speed 0.384 vs twin 0.421
pass: single front by t~12, speed 0.385 vs twin 0.418
pass at dt/2 (world dt=5e-4): speed 0.416 vs twin 0.454
fail at a 45% cut (outside the claim's 15-30%): the cell retracts and vanishes by t=8.8

controls_run.R: cuts/s5_front30 and cuts/s6_front30: branched undamaged twin, same seed and noise stream after the branch; cuts/s6_front45: larger cut, fatal
controls_run.M: not re-run; the author's linear-kinetics twin (pack_linear) is in the claim

verdicts.limitation: Only polarity and crawling recover: the cut cell stays at 66% of its twin's area for 10 time units (the cut removed protein, and the cell's area follows the protein budget), so the body is not rebuilt. The repair window is narrow: 30% of the front is repaired, 45% is fatal (seed 6), and erasing the whole polarity domain is fatal (the author's chem arm). The shape smoothing is curvature flow and counts under mechanism. bd_supported rests on the author's linear twin, which I read but did not re-run. The cell is planted, so this is not S.
